description:
- Fixed Wi-Fi reminders: required permissions are requested, network names match correctly, and reminders also work when the phone is already connected to the selected network.
- Wi-Fi and location monitoring no longer stops after 10 minutes. Monitoring recovers after the app restarts or permissions are granted.
- Recurring location reminders stay active and rearm after leaving the selected area. Repeated callbacks and pending delayed alerts no longer create duplicate notifications.
- Fixed a crash when combining a location or Wi-Fi trigger with the ordinary repeat-task option.
